name: profile_4k_24p_stable
verified_from: CT6_20261127T002325Z_a6700_dump (read-only read-back after a stable MOVIE recording)
result_observed: MP4 S-Log3 3840x2560 at 23.98p, ~97.6 Mbps; steady picture, recording did not stop.
summary: 4K Open Gate. 3840x2560 (3:2) using the contributed full encoder design (the stable step chain L13 + L5 + L16 + M19 + S16). This is the chain that recorded cleanly; the L19 (high-speed-only) encoder rebooted the kernel on the switch to MOVIE and must NOT be used.

sensor_window.note: Contributed 4K window. 3876 of the 3968 native 3:2 rows => picture is ~2.4% too tall (3876/3968 = 0.977). profile_true_3x2_experimental removes that.

verify_rule: Read every write's address first; each must equal its 'stock' (or 'stock_sha256'). If any site differs, abort the whole profile before writing one byte (wrong firmware or already patched).

steps.label: raw write buffer (memory manager)
steps.desc: Enlarge the four raw write-buffer size words so the taller frame fits.

steps.label: sensor drive window
steps.desc: Open the sensor read-out window to 3876 rows from row 214 for drive modes 0x820/0x880/0x890/0x8c0/0x8d0 (0x830 left stock). Window geometry is declarative (above); the per-register byte values are firmware-derived.
steps.payload_note: 6 sensor-register cells. Firmware-derived bytes: NOT in this MIT repo. Supply from the GPL kit; the injector verifies them by sha256 before and after.

steps.label: encoder output size
steps.desc: Set the movie-writer output size word to 3840x2560.

steps.label: full encoder design (ogfile2560_full_a6700_v1)
steps.desc: The contributed full encoder design: 3840x2560 at 24/25/50p. This is the stable encoder (483 av-cam.bin spans). The anchors below are the two 3000-byte encoder records; the remaining spans/cells travel in the same payload.
steps.payload_note: Firmware-derived encoder bytes: NOT in this MIT repo. Supply from the GPL kit. The injector verifies by sha256 before (stock) and after (target).
steps.side_effect: Movie size table entry id 0x2d9 changes 3840x2160 -> 3840x2560 (same payload).

steps.label: screen / display fit
steps.desc: Make the rear 3:2 panel show the full frame (height 404 -> 480) and clear the 16:9 letterbox fit words.

notes: RAM only: a cold boot (battery out ~10 s) reverts everything. Whether the power switch alone reverts on the A6700 is unknown.
In-camera playback of the 3840x2560 clips needs the separate playback_fix profile.
Do NOT use the L19 encoder: it rebooted the kernel on the MOVIE switch (CT6_20261127T001105Z). M19 is the stable replacement.
